context_requirements: Expression of the IL5 receptor complex (IL5RA and CSF2RB) on the target cell
Presence of an IL5-responsive cell type; the nine lines are non-hematopoietic and do not express the receptor
Active IL5/IL5RA signaling at baseline; no autocrine IL5 loop is known in these lines
falsifiers: Reproducible transcriptional changes in any of the nine lines at 6 h or 24 h after 10 µM drug treatment
Dose-dependent modulation of IL5RA or CSF2RB target genes in these lines
Any shared signature across the nine lines that is absent in vehicle controls
